name: JoAi: Create Segment

description.en: Create a saved audience segment. Conditions AND together. Contact conditions: tag, has_email, has_phone, created_after, created_before, email_contains, …. Install (push) conditions: has_install, install_push_status (subscribed|opted_out|unavailable).
description.de: Erstelle ein gespeichertes Zielgruppen-Segment. Bedingungen gelten UND-verknüpft. Kontakt: tag, has_email, has_phone, created_after, created_before, email_contains, …. Installationen (Push): has_install, install_push_status (subscribed|opted_out|unavailable).
description.fr: Créez un segment d'audience. Conditions en ET. Contacts : tag, has_email, has_phone, created_after, created_before, email_contains, …. Installations (push) : has_install, install_push_status (subscribed|opted_out|unavailable).
description.es: Crea un segmento de audiencia. Condiciones en Y. Contactos: tag, has_email, has_phone, created_after, created_before, email_contains, …. Instalaciones (push): has_install, install_push_status (subscribed|opted_out|unavailable).
description.it: Crea un segmento di pubblico. Condizioni in AND. Contatti: tag, has_email, has_phone, created_after, created_before, email_contains, …. Installazioni (push): has_install, install_push_status (subscribed|opted_out|unavailable).
description.ro: Creează un segment de audiență. Condițiile se aplică cu ȘI. Contacte: tag, has_email, has_phone, created_after, created_before, email_contains, …. Instalări (push): has_install, install_push_status (subscribed|opted_out|unavailable).

bot: Build reusable audiences. Pass conditions as [{"type":"tag","value":"vip"}]. For push campaigns targeting all subscribed devices (including anonymous), use install-only conditions: [{"type":"has_install","value":true},{"type":"install_push_status","value":"subscribed"}]. Do not mix install-only conditions with contact tag filters if you want anonymous installs included.
